Data: open the plot as the data tables

Source: R/mira_mode.R
mira_mode_data.Rd

Opens the plot in MiRA's data mode: the network's tables (nodes, state nodes, links, layers), with every attribute, sortable and filterable, and Export CSV. A filter set there applies to network, grid and map modes (its layers also to the layer view), like mira_filter() from R. It opens on the nodes table with every row; the other components of the plot do not apply (see mira_mode). In MiRA, the data button (a table) opens this view.

Usage

mira_mode_data()

Value

A component, to add to a plot with +.

Details

See also

mira_filter() to filter from R; mira_mode for the other views.

Other components: mira_camera(), mira_filter(), mira_interlayer(), mira_intralayer(), mira_layer(), mira_layout(), mira_legends(), mira_mode, mira_mode_dashboard(), mira_mode_grid(), mira_mode_layer(), mira_mode_map(), mira_mode_meta(), mira_node()

Examples

library(emln)
net <- load_emln(17)
#> Creating state node map
#> Creating extended link list with node IDs
mira(net, bipartite = TRUE, setA_type = "bird") + mira_mode_data()
#> Bipartite network: drawn as undirected. Use directed = TRUE for a directed one.
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.
